campaign.name: And Then the Dragons Came: Purewater
campaign.description: A Classic Fantasy Imperative port of 'And then the Dragons Came', relocated to Purewater -- a Venice-like canal city where the sacred waters of the Lake Lady meet the sea. Baron Hanzo di Teufel arrives with his Dragon Knights for the Lake Lady's Tourney, his possessed champion concealed among them. Four strangers arrive the same week. Built as a living world: every NPC and faction runs its own agenda on a clock, and what the party does not witness happens anyway.

acts.title: THE HUNT
acts.for: Put Nimras in reach of his quarry and a physical magical threat. G1 offers pursuit, counter-magic, restraint, bargaining and an early recovery that stands.
acts.takes: At risk are the teacher's freedom, the manuscript and people in the hunt's path. No injury, capture or escape is predetermined.

acts.title: THE PACK
acts.for: Contest workshop, handlers, copies and transport. G2 and G3 are actual attempts requiring surviving assets and information. Authorities and city powers can provide real help. Nimras can separate rivals or strike their dependencies in any order.
acts.takes: At risk are control of the constructs, custody of useful research and the ability to prevent coercive export. No compulsory betrayal or compensating defeat.

acts.title: WHO KEEPS THE HOUNDS
acts.for: Settle surviving transport, research and personal obligations. G4 cannot depart without actual loading and pilot; G5 can resolve immediately whenever recovery is achieved. Recalculate dates after play, and never hold an early victory for this act.
acts.takes: At risk are lasting availability of mage-hunting tools and professional relationships. Clear victory, partial victory, negotiated settlement, failure and withdrawal have distinct concrete results in the GM plan.

nimras.name: Nimras
nimras.description: Nimras: human Rank 2 Magic-User, freelance mage hunter trained by an independent fellowship. Left amicably to spread his wings. Review draft; not yet in play.
nimras.content: Nimras is a freelance mage hunter trained by an independent fellowship. He left on good terms to choose his own work and establish his independence. The fellowship has commissioned him to find his former teacher Rennic Vaur in Purewater and recover an entrusted manuscript. His introduction to Oren Vey is his first proposed lead. He holds no Crown warrant. Alignment and passions remain the player’s choice. No arrival, target sighting or scene has been played.

cfi_rules_notes: Rank 2: base 2 AP +1; base POW Luck 3 + human 1 + Rank 2 table 1 =5.
